items.detail: A directory of ESS documents is compiled by ess-compiler to the resolved IR; a document ESS refuses is refused with ESS's diagnostics.
items.label: Load and compile

items.detail: Entities need store.durable, periodic bindings timer and clock, cross-component bindings channel, external outcomes external.<command>.<outcome>.
items.label: Derived from the specification

items.detail: capabilities --component lists only what one component needs when it runs on its own.
items.label: Per component

items.detail: Each required capability is bound to the first implementation the environment lists for it; an exact key wins over a prefix key.
items.label: Bind by preference

items.detail: A refused admission names every capability without an implementation and exits 3.
items.label: Refusal names what is missing

items.detail: spindle-kernel selects the outcome by the IR's conditions and guards, applies its effect and emits its events; b10x-spindle run reads commands as JSON lines.
items.label: Commands against the compiled model

items.detail: The store follows the store.durable binding; SQLite state survives a restart.
items.label: Memory and SQLite stores

items.detail: spindle-store-browser keeps instances in the browser's IndexedDB (store.durable bound to indexeddb in examples/environments/browser.toml): it passes the store contract the memory and SQLite stores pass, and a command's effect is read back after the database is reopened. The Service Worker host opens one per component whose state is bound to indexeddb.
items.label: Browser store

items.detail: spindle-wasm compiles a specification in the browser, admits it on a browser environment (ingress.network bound to service-worker) and answers its routes and the console routes from a Service Worker through the same router the loopback listener calls, state in IndexedDB and external outcomes answered from a decisions file; web/ is the Vue shell that registers the worker.
items.label: Service Worker host

items.detail: spindle-timer yields due ticks for periodic bindings on an injected clock, honouring the ESS periodic profile.
items.label: Periodic bindings

items.detail: spindle-channel carries an event to the command it binds to, in process or as length-prefixed JSON frames over TCP; the receiver acknowledges an at_least_once envelope, and no runtime path resends one whose acknowledgement is overdue.
items.label: Event bindings in process and over TCP

items.detail: An on_failure: retry binding runs its command again at once after each refused or failed attempt, up to 5 attempts, before the next envelope runs; each attempt and each given-up invocation is counted. A per-refusal policy (on_failure with named refusals) retries or drops by refusal, with the same limit. --drop-retries runs every retrying binding as a drop binding.
items.label: Retry on failure

items.detail: b10x-spindle play runs the three rally components in one process with in-process channels until a side wins.
items.label: Every component in one process

items.detail: Placement refuses an instance above its target's ceiling; the process launcher starts and stops an instance and reports its exit.
items.label: The target contract and the process launcher

items.detail: A library launcher: one qemu-system-x86_64 -M microvm per instance with KVM, without root. Its tests run on a host with /dev/kvm (task check:vm), not in CI.
items.label: QEMU microvm launcher

items.detail: A library launcher: Firecracker VMs on a bridge inside a user and network namespace, without root. Its tests need /dev/kvm, the Firecracker binary and a guest kernel (task check:vm), not in CI.
items.label: Firecracker launcher

items.detail: run --decisions answers external outcomes from a TOML file, per command or for all, for stdin lines and served requests; --answer-default takes a command's default branch.
items.label: External decisions from a file

items.detail: A creation whose identity no input or payload supplies needs identity.mint; a Uuid identity is minted as a UUIDv4, a String newtype identity as its prefix and a UUIDv4's text, and emitted.
items.label: Minted creation identities

items.detail: An outcome that declares deletes: on the instance its input names removes the row as ESS's interpreter does: it leaves every view, a later command on the identity answers as an unknown instance, and the outcome's events are published; on SQLite the removal survives a restart.
items.label: Deleting outcomes

items.detail: An outcome that declares instances: selects every row of its entity whose filter holds, read from the store before the outcome, and moves, updates or removes each in ascending order of identity as ESS's interpreter does; a move skips a row outside its from states, and zero rows selected is a successful outcome. {count: changed} reads how many rows changed, and an event declared once per changed row is published once for each. A filter that walks the rows of an entity stays refused, by name.
items.label: Set outcomes

items.detail: List views over every instance of an entity, with a state filter and an order.
items.label: List views with filters

items.detail: spindle-telemetry counts commands by outcome, events, bindings, timer ticks and store writes per component; b10x-spindle metrics prints the catalogue, play prints the table's counters.
items.label: Counters derived from the specification

items.detail: Launchers read CPU seconds and resident memory per instance from /proc and its share of the requested quota.
items.label: Host-side resource sampling

items.detail: An instance that starts the spindle-telemetry sender sends its cumulative counters and its own resource readings as spindle-telemetry/1 frames every second, over a Unix socket for a process and vsock for QEMU and Firecracker, and drops and counts frames no collector takes.
items.label: Telemetry transport

items.detail: The spindle.observe domain specifies the API answers; their JSON Schema, Rust and TypeScript types are generated and drift-checked.
items.label: The observe API contract

items.detail: A Vue 3 app in ui/ with topology, instance and view screens, built and tested on fixture answers; no live data until the control process exists.
items.label: The observe UI, on fixtures

items.detail: Three b10x-spindle play --component processes, one per component, started by the process launcher from its SPINDLE_* variables and joined by TCP channels, play a match to a winner; each sends its telemetry when given an endpoint.
items.label: Three processes

items.detail: Each rally component in its own microVM, one b10x-spindle play per VM in its per-component mode, joined by TCP channels across the VM network, plays a match to a winner; one placement (examples/rally/placement.toml) runs on QEMU and on Firecracker. Its tests run on a host with /dev/kvm (task check:vm), not in CI.
items.label: Three microVMs

items.detail: run serves the accepted commands and views over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 where ingress.network is bound to http-loopback: at the routes ess generate --kind openapi publishes, with or without an ess-http/1 binding, answering the envelope ESS publishes.
items.label: HTTP ingress

items.detail: A command an ess-http/1 binding puts on method: delete is served at its path: a DELETE with no body runs with the input its path carries and answers the status the binding lists; a method the path does not serve answers 405 with Allow naming DELETE.
items.label: DELETE routes

items.detail: A view that declares parameters is served: each is read from the path or the query string where the OpenAPI document ESS publishes places it, and the view answers the rows ESS's interpreter answers for those values; a required parameter left out, or one not of its declared type, is refused 400 naming it.
items.label: View parameters

items.detail: A command an ess-http/1 binding reads as request: {encoding: form} or {encoding: query} is served: its input is read from an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body or from the query string, each value by its field's type as ESS's served application reads it; an undeclared field, one the path carries, or a form body under another Content-Type is refused 400 and writes nothing.
items.label: Form and query requests

items.detail: A command outcome an ess-http/1 binding answers with body: response, body: response.<field> or body: none answers its bound status with the command's response bare, the one field's value bare, or no body and no Content-Type, as ess generate --kind openapi publishes it; one bound with headers, a redirect or the text encoding answers 501 naming which.
items.label: Outcome bodies

items.detail: A refusing outcome an ess-http/1 binding answers with body: {<member>: error} answers its bound status with an object whose <member> is the error's wire name, beside the error's fields under their wire names, as ess generate --kind openapi publishes it, and writes nothing.
items.label: Error object bodies

items.detail: A loopback run also serves GET /api/model (the IR as ess specify compile prints it, and each outcome's subject), GET /api/events (every event published, in order) and POST /api/reset (empties every store); a route the binding or ESS publishes at one of those paths is refused at startup.
items.label: Console routes

items.detail: POST /api/reset may carry a world: rows checked by ESS and written where their entity rests, a decision table answering external causes and a seed identities are minted from, each until the next reset; a world that does not validate is refused 400 and changes nothing.
items.label: A world per reset

items.detail: An HTTP run serves every command and view that runs and answers each other one 501 naming the construct, ESS's envelope for a command; the list is printed at startup, in name order. A view the ingress cannot route answers 501 naming the construct too, and is listed at startup. SQLite state without --state is kept in a temporary directory removed when the run ends.
items.label: Serve what runs

items.detail: run --fixed-actor with --fixed-caller sends served commands as actors and callers fixed for the whole run, so a command that reads its caller is served: a test-backend switch, not authentication, opt-in only and printed on stderr at startup. The grant check still runs: a command the actor may not send answers 403 not granted and writes nothing. Given more than once, each command is sent as the first fixed actor its grant names.
items.label: Fixed caller (test backend)

items.detail: run --trusted-caller-header reads each request's actor and caller attributes from one JSON header a proxy in front of the ingress sets once it has authenticated the request, so a command that reads its caller runs for that caller and a read-granted view is read as it. The proxy is trusted by a shared secret: --trusted-caller-secret names the file holding it, and the proxy presents it on every request in the Spindle-Proxy-Secret header. A request without a valid caller header or the right secret is refused 403 not granted naming no actor and writes nothing, and so is a console or /__spindle/ request without the secret; the secret is never printed. The ingress must be reachable only through the proxy, which must remove both headers from client requests.
items.label: Caller proven by a trusted proxy header

items.detail: run --scenario replays an ess-scenario document through ESS's reader and conformance runner: an entity it arranges with setup is written into the store of the component that owns it, captures feed later steps, view asserts are checked, and the first divergent step is named and ends the run.
items.label: Scenario replay

items.detail: conform runs the suite ESS synthesises from a specification, or one written for it, against every component in one process; task check runs it on Spindle's own specification, lists every synthesis refusal with its code and holds the executed and skipped counts.
items.label: Self-conformance

items.detail: b10x-spindle deploy places and launches the instances of a spindle-placement/1 document on process targets, collects their samples, keeps the last 15 minutes and serves the read-only observe API and the UI embedded in the binary on 127.0.0.1, with a token and a Host check.
items.label: The control process

items.detail: Upload a bundle to deploy it; design milestone M4, no story yet.
items.label: Bundle, deploy service and registry

items.detail: Cells across threads, ownership leases with fencing, snapshots; design milestone M5, no story yet.
items.label: Cells, ownership and snapshots
